invariants.rationale: The first line of computeSize sets sizeInvalid to false.
tablePrefWidth is set to the maximum of itself and tableMinWidth.
tablePrefHeight is set to the maximum of itself and tableMinHeight.
tableMinWidth is initialized to hpadding (sum of paddings) and incremented by columnMinWidth elements, which are floats representing widths—always non-negative after Math.max.
tableMinHeight is the sum of vertical paddings and rowMinHeight values, all of which are non-negative.
